module: Anti-repetition system of the "Gymkhana" challenge mode: it keeps the history of figures (normal drifts and stunt zones) and computes a multiplier (stallingValue, between 0.5 and 1) that reduces the score when the player repeats the same figure. Loaded by gameplay_drift_general when the challenge mode is "Gymkhana". Also contains a debug imgui window.
notes: Settings: minStallingValue 0.5, maxStallingValue 1, history considered = last 10 figures. Normal drift (stuntId 0): +0.35 on figure change, -0.15 beyond 5 repetitions. Stunt zone: +1, -0.6 beyond 1 repetition.
The multiplier stays at 1 as long as the history contains fewer than 2 entries or fewer than 2 different figures.
The multiplier equals score/maxPossibleScore clamped; if maxPossibleScore stays at 0, the division gives NaN/inf before clamping (math.max/min).
The variable stuntZonesCount is reset to -1 but is never used elsewhere (dead code).

reset.desc: Clears the history and resets the multiplier to 1.

calculateScore.desc: Applies the stalling multiplier to a score.

processStuntZone.desc: Adds a stunt zone to the history (type "stuntZone") and recomputes the multiplier.

stuntZoneId.desc: Zone identifier; a non-zero value distinguishes it from normal drifts.

onDriftStatusChanged.desc: Hook: when the player starts drifting, adds a drift (stuntId 0) to the history and recomputes the multiplier.

isDrifting.desc: true at the start of a drift.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: displays the "Drift stalling system" debug window if enabled.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=true, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.
